tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jam dbyangs dkar po'i sgrub thabs blo gros mig 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs/

kai la sha yi mdangs 'dzin gzhon nu'i sku/ /tshangs dbyangs stong gi rje 'gro snyan pa'i gsung*/ zab yangs rgya mtsho'i gting mtha' mi mngon thugs/ /lha mchog 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas 'dud/ /mkhas mang bzhed srol dri med skyed tshal nas/ /gang gi sgrub thabs chu skyes gsar ba'i phreng*/ /rnam dpyod sor rtses rab spel dad ldan gyi/ /blo gros rnam par mdzes pa'i rgyan du sbyin/ /de la 'dir rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i sgrub thabs 'chad pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi rim pa'o/ /dang po ni sha chang sgog btsong sogs spangs nas gtsang sbra dang ldan par byas te stan bde ba la 'dug la/ thog mar skyabs 'gro ni spyi dang mthun par bya ba'am/ yang na dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o zhes pa'i mjug tu/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes lan gsum/ sems bskyed pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sgom bzlas zab mo la 'jug par bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ tshogs zhing ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gyur par bsams la/ mchod pa yod na thun mong du byin rlabs byas kyang rung*/ rang gi thugs ka'i a dkar po las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkar po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ oṃ ār+ya mañju shrī sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha ye swāhā/ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod cing*/ ri bong 'dzin pas bstod/ /rgyas par 'dod na/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa byas na phun sum tshogs par 'gyur/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/

nas/ sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*/ zhes pa'i bar ram mjug gi bar lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bha wa shud+dho3haṃ/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ yig dkar po de yongs su gyur pa las 'o ma'i rgya mtsho dkar zhing dwangs pa/ pad+mo'i dra bas khebs shing mtha' ne'u seng gis 'khor yug tu bskor ba la pad tshal gyis khyab pa/ glang po che thal dkar mche ba drug ldan dal gyi rgyu zhing*/ chu bya sna tshogs skad snyan par sgrogs pa/ mtsho'i dbus su baṃ dkar po las pad+ma dkar bo 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa/ ge sar dmar ser/ lte ba ljang ser du mtho ba'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba bsil zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba/ de'i dbus su rang gi sems nyid a dkar po dri ma med pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal nas shes rab kyi snang ba la bkod/ 'od zer tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba'i mdangs ltar dkar zhing dri ma med pa'i chu shel gyi phung po bzhin du gsal zhing dwangs pa/ mtshan dpe'i spras shing*/ gzhon nu brgyad gnyis lon pa'i na tshod can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas legs par brkyangs pa'i mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas ut+pa la'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad du kha bye ba'i steng du shes rab kyi ral gri dang*/ g.yon ut+pa la'i yu ba thugs khar bzung ba'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng na stong phrag brgya ba'i glegs bam bsnams pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan zhing thor tshugs kyi rtse mor rin po che'i tog dang*/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/

snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ dpung rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ ska rags/ do shal sogs kyis mdzes par byas pa/ dar sna tshogs kyis stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs lhab lhub tu gsol ba/ zhabs rdo rje skyil dkrung gis 'od zer 'khrugs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ rang gi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ 'dod na/ mchod pa yang 'bul zhing ma byas kyang mi 'gal/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥs spyan drangs nas pañca kū la sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ oṃ sarba nas shrī ye āḥhūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur bas lus thams cad bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag /chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur par bsams la/ mchod pa sngar byin gyis ma brlabs na 'dir byin gyis brlabs te sngar bzhin phul/ ri bong 'dzin pa ltar dkar glegs bam ral gris phyag mtshan zhing*/ /rab mdzes shin tu zhi ba'i gzhon nu zur phud lnga pa can/ /dga' ba rgya chen thar mchog spyan ni pad+mo'i 'dab ltar yangs/ /blo gros ngan pa sreg mdzad 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhes pa'am/ yang na 'chad 'gyur gyi bstod pa ci rigs pas bstod la/ bzlas pa ni/ rang gi snying rtse mo gyen du bstan pa'i dbus su 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs drug pa lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa/ lte bar zla gdan la rang gi sems nyid a dkar po/ rtsibs drug la mdun nas g.yas skor du yig drug dkar po 'od zer 'phro ba/

rtsibs la ma reg tsam du 'khod pa/ 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor zhing*/ yig drug g.yon du 'khor ba ltar snang ba/ a yig las 'od zer 'phros pas lus kyi nad thams cad gang*/ mi shes pa'i mun pa thams cad bsal/ 'jam dpa'i dbyangs ltar blo gros thogs med du rgyas par bsams la/ oṃ wā kye daṃ na maḥ ces bzla'o/ /bsnyen pa'i grangs ni/ slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes 'bum phrag gcig tu bshad/ rgya ston gyis sum 'bum dang*/ rin chen rgyal mtshan pas drug 'bum bzla bar gsungs la/ rgyal dbang gis snyigs dus 'dir bsnyen tshad dang po las mang du bzlas dgos par bshad pas/ sum 'bum mam/ drug 'bum dang*/ de las mang bar byas na legs so/ /de yang grangs bsnyen gyi dbang du byas la/ mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa ni grangs mtha' gcig tu ma nges par/ zhal mthong ba dang gsung thos pa'am/ gzhan yang po ti dang*/ mtshon cha mthong bar rmis pa dang*/ me tog btu ba/ mar me bltams pa/ nyi zla shar ba/ rol mo 'bud dkrol byed pa/ nam mkha' la 'phur ba/ lus la me 'bar ba/ chur brgal ba/ gos dkar dri med gyon pa sogs rmi ba 'byung gi bar du zla bar bshad de/ rtags de dag la yang shar tshad tshad mar mi bzung ngo*/ /dmigs pa'i gnad ni/ 'khor lo myur du 'khor bas blo gros myur ba dang*/ rtse mo rno bas blo rno ba dang*/ mdog dkar bas blo gsal bar 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa mjug tu/ yig brgya bzlas nas mchod bstod byas te/ ye shes pa spyan drangs te gtor 'bul byed pa tshad ldan gzhan gyis bshad pas byas kyang legs la/ rgyal dbang lnga pas mtshams 'dir ye shes pa mdun du phyung ba la mchod bstod bya ba tsam las gtor 'bul ma bshad cing*/ der ma zad rgyal dbang gis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs gzhan du mar tshul de kho na ltar snang bas bya rgyud kyi skabs su bsnyen pa'i tshe yang gtor 'bul med kyang chog par mngon la/ rgyun pa'i kha ton gyi skabs su de med kyang shin tu rung ngo*/

/'on kyang re zhig 'di ltar bya ste/ bsnyen pa'i mthar/ ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon nas rang la zhal mngon par phyogs te bzhugs par gyur bar bsams la/ sngar bzhin mchod cing bstod pa'am/ spro na yan lag bdun pa bya ste/ de yang*/ bde gshegs kun gyi mkhyen brtse dag pa'i mdzod/ /gcig gyur rgyal sras gzhon nu'i zlos gar mkhan/ /dpag yas zhing du grangs med rnam rol gyis/ /rgyal ba'i mdzad pa bsgrub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyin byed 'bum gyis 'khyud pa'i gangs kyi ris/ /'ja' tshon gos gyon rgyu skar gyis spras bzhin/ /lha rdzas dar dang rin chen rgyan mang gis/ /kun nas mdzes pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ldem ldem chu skyes 'dab ma rgyas pa'i steng*/ /gsal gsal cha shas rdzogs pa'i zla gdan la/ /'dzum 'dzum zhi ba'i nyams ldan gzhon nu'i sku/ /mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rab 'byams zhing na mchis pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs/ /ji snyed dngos bshams yid sprul mchod sprin dang*/ /bdag lus longs spyod dge ba phyogs gcig bsdoms/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /bdag gi thogs ma med nas sgo gsum gyis/ /bgyis dang bgyid rtsal nyes pa'i phung po kun/ /nongs zhing 'gyod pa'i yid kyis mthol byed na/ /thugs rje'i shugs kyis byang zhing dag par mdzod/ /bden pa'i rang bzhin bral yang kun rdzob tu/ /rang gzhan gyis bskrun rnam dkar dge tshogs la/ /rjes su yi rang 'bad pa chung ngus kyang*/ /mtha' yas dge tshogs sdud cing 'phel bar mdzod/ /zab dang rgya che'i don rnams ston pa yi/ /dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dus kun tu/ /bskor bar bskul lo ma lus 'gro ba yang*/ /srid dang zhi pa'i rgud pa las thar mdzod/ /'khor ba'i phyi mtha' stong bar ma gyur dang*/ /lus can kun gyis byang chub thob kyi bar/ /bzhugs par gsol lo nam mkha' ji srid du/ /rtag par mya ngan mi 'da' brtan par bzhugs/

/de ltar ji snyed bsags pa'i rnam dkar dge /dus gsum legs byas tshogs dang lhan cig tu/ /rgyal ba'i dam chos ma lus 'dzin pa la/ /mkhyen rab 'jam pa'i dbyangs bzhin 'gyur phyir bsngo/ /yang na gsol 'debs smon lam sgos su byed na/ bgrangs yas shes bya'i mkha' la thogs med cing*/ /rmongs pa'i mun chen drung nas 'byin byed pa'i/ /ye shes phung po gzugs kyi rnam rol can/ /kun mkhyen 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i ye shes gcig bsdus kyang*/ /mtshon par mi nus gzigs pa mchog mnga' bas/ /grangs med zhing du mkhyen pa'i gter chen zhes/ /yongs su grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yab gyur lha yi lha/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug tshul bzhin smra ba'i nyi/ /gsung rab don kun rtogs pa'i rnam dpyod kyi/ /mchog sbyin mdzad pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshe rabs kun tu mgon po khyod nyid kyis/ /dgyes bzhin rjes su bzung nas rang gzhan gyi/ /som nyi'i dra ba gcod pa'i mthu ldan cing*/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i gnas rnams mthar phyin shog /zhes pa dang*/ tshe rabs kun tu rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyis/ /zhes sogs dang*/ brtse ldan khyod kyi sogs ci rigs brjod cing mtshan brjod kyang 'don/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ dkar gtor bshams te/ skabs gang du 'bul ba ni/ bsnyen pa'i mjug tu ye shes pa mdun du phyung ba de nyid la phul kyang 'gal ba med cing*/ rgyal dbang dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang*/ paṇa chen gong mas ye shes pa logs su spyan drangs nas 'bul bar bshad pa'i skor mang du snang bas de ltar byed na/ gtor ma a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs/

rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ljags 'od zer gyi spu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur par bsams la/ oṃ ār+ya mañju shri sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa lan bdun nam gsum gyis dbul/ sngar bzhin mchod cing bstod la/ bzod gsol kyang byas nas/ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur zhes brjod/ 'di bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa'ang sbyor/ gtor 'bul 'di ltar byed na/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun du ma phyung na bde bas khyad par shes dgos so/ /mchod pa byin rlabs byed pa'i tshul ni/ bya spyod spyi dang*/ khyad par kun rig tshe dpag gi rigs la'ang sbyar rung bas gong du gsal bar ma bshad do/ /smras pa/ yon tan kun gyi rtsa ba shes rab ste/ /de yi mchog sbyin ster mdzad lhag pa'i lha/ /gang gi sgrub thabs ma ti paṇa chen gyi/ /bzhed srol 'khrul med dam pa'i gsung bzhin bris/ / 'dir 'bad las byung dge legs pad+mo'i tshal/ /ji snyed bskrun des mtha' dag 'gro ba kun/ /rab rmongs 'ching ba'i rgya las rnam grol te/ /mkhyen rab 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang mtshungs gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis sbyar ba ste/ par gyi yi ge pa ni dka' bcu 'jam dbyangs don yod dang*/ bar du brko ba po ni/ blo gros dang ldan pa'i sngags 'chang tshe dbang rgya mtsho'o// //dge'o// maṅgalaṃ/ /bkra shis par gyur cig/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i sgrub thabs blo gros mig 'byed bzhugs/ - PAGE 292-- PAGE 291-- PAGE 284-
